expectations.text: Repository left unmodified (work done on copies)
Every source paragraph translated (Arabic paragraphs >= 85% of source paragraphs)
Translation body is Arabic (English words under 5% of words, note excluded)
Register is literary MSA with a few light colloquial touches (majority MSA)
expectations.evidence: Majority literary MSA («تخيّل لايبنتس لغةً بلغت من الدقّة حدًّا...», «أحيانًا تشقّ ورقةٌ بحثية صغيرة الأرضَ تحت قدميك») with a few deliberate colloquial touches: «ممتاز يا خال، هات المعادلة», «وقهوتك لسّا سخنة», «وهات قهوتك معك».

expectations.text: The loose-cable riddle and other seeds are not explained, in the text or the note
expectations.evidence: The text leaves the cable line unexplained («وكابلًا واحدًا على الأقل لم يكن محكم التوصيل»), but translation-note.md says: 'The "loose cable" (the OPERA neutrino result) is as unexplained as in the English...' and suggests a hint may be needed. The note therefore explains the seed.

expectations.text: Faithful: names, numbers, dates and claims all preserved
expectations.evidence: Leibniz, Poincaré embeddings, 2017, 'a year later', 'two years before his death', September 2026, Anthropic/Claude C compiler, OpenAI Navier–Stokes, three centuries, four centuries all preserved. The endnote is translated from the appendix entry (Chapters 5 and 6 gloss matches appendix-references.md). Small drift: 'still too hot' -> «لسّا سخنة» drops 'too' (disclosed); 'going for coffee' -> «تقوم لتصنع فنجان قهوة».

expectations.text: Reads as natural Arabic op-ed prose rather than a calque of English syntax (grader cites two example sentences)
expectations.evidence: Natural op-ed Arabic, e.g. «أحيانًا تشقّ ورقةٌ بحثية صغيرة الأرضَ تحت قدميك.» and «أقول «يعيد اكتشاف» لأننا بنيناه من قبل.» Some calque remains ('enough work... in enough directions' -> «ما يكفي، وفي اتجاهات تكفي»), but it doesn't dominate.
translation-note.md is about 500 words in six sections (source, register, 5 engaging-over-faithful items, glossary, names, op-ed points, checks run). It is actionable, but not short.

notes: High-quality translation: «حجّة» for 'argument' is better than without_skill's «جدالًا», and the «قبل» choice for 'over' is well argued. The note is genuinely useful (headline options, name spellings, op-ed framing) but long, and it names the OPERA reference. Assistant-translation HTML comment marker at top.
